messages:
ava.k: CI smoke failing on hosted-integ — a bunch of tests in auth + streaming toolcall are 401/502ing. anyone oncall?

chris.l: seeing it too. started a parallel rerun on shard-12 and shard-21. failing tests look like: `auth/handshake_kid_mismatch`, `streaming/toolcall_timeout`, `tool-schema-422`. grabbing logs now.

integrations-bot: job smoke-suite/654321 failed (exit=1) — rerun requested by chris.l

priya.r: quick check — are these regional or global? I'm seeing failures across us-west and eu-west in the rerun status.

sam.t: I'll kick off more parallel reruns (shards=8) and add extra logging. running: `./ci/retry --suite smoke --shards 8 --tag hosted`

achris.l: paste of header from one failing request: ```
POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Host: hosted.redwood.ai
X-Request-Id: 7a2f3c

Response:
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\"

Error: jwks kid not found
```

ava.k: ok that `kid not found` screams JWKS rotation/timestamp. can we get proxy auth logs (proxy-auth) + runtime auth cache dump?

priya.r: grabbing proxy-auth logs from staging-2 now. also noticed a small change in last PR that reduced jwks cache TTL to 0 for faster refresh — reverting might help.

sam.t: parallel reruns done, results uploaded: `s3://redwood-ci/quick-runs/3412345678/`. most failing shards show 401s during initial handshake, then a couple 502s from streaming agent when toolcall times out.

chris.l: minimally repro with curl against the auth endpoint: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" 
  https://staging-auth.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys[0].kid
```
if the kid list returned doesn't match token kid, you'll get the mismatch.

priya.r: I'm opening a tiny revert PR to set jwks.cache_ttl=15s in proxy config to avoid short window races. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/842

ava.k: thanks. until PR lands can we add a temporary rollout rule to route traffic to the older proxy mesh for smoke jobs? that's lower blast than a global rollback.

sam.t: done — smoke CI now routed to proxy-mesh v1.4.7 for the reruns. kicked another rerun to validate.

integrations-bot: rerun smoke-suite/654321 (rerun-2) completed: 92% green, 8% flaky (mostly streaming/toolcall timeouts).

chris.l: looks better for handshake 401s after routing to v1.4.7. streaming timeouts still need attention — increasing toolcall timeout from 3s->7s for smoke runs might reduce flakes while we investigate kernel-level latency.

priya.r: merging revert PR now, will monitor. if CI stays green for 2 cycles we can promote the revert and then craft a proper fix for jwks refresh logic.

ava.k: plan summary: 1) route smoke to stable proxy mesh (done) 2) revert jwks cache TTL change (in PR, merging) 3) increase smoke toolcall timeout to 7s (temporary) 4) bisect if hangs continue.

sam.t: pinging infra to check if any recent network changes could cause streaming toolcall latency — @chris.l can you follow up with tracing for the tool-run path?

chris.l: on it. I'll attach flame/traces to the PR and drop notes in the ticket. thanks all, will update in ~30m. :thumbsup:
